description: Start a headless page that stays open between tool calls (op start), so a scene that takes long to load or a state that is hard to reach is loaded once; three_page then looks at it and drives it. op status lists the open pages, op stop closes one. It stops by itself after 10 minutes without calls. Several pages can run side by side under different names (default main).

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

wait.description: ms to let the scene run after load (default 1500)

name: three_session
title: Keep a three.js page running between calls
